lines.zh: 草原太开阔，我贴着坡走。
lines.en: The plain is too open; I hug the slope instead.

lines.zh: 爪尖踩过石子，几乎无声。
lines.en: My claws cross the gravel almost silently.

lines.zh: 我三步一停，先看风往哪吹。
lines.en: Three steps, one pause; I check the wind.

lines.zh: 沙地上留下两行细长的印。
lines.en: Two thin rows of prints trail across the sand.
I skirt the water; the bank is too slick.
When I run, my tail takes the corner first.

lines.zh: 这片林子我认得，放心走。
lines.en: I know this wood; you can walk easy.

lines.zh: 我走得很轻，像怕吵醒什么。
lines.en: I step lightly, as if something might wake.
My foreclaw tests first; the hind leg follows.
Grass drags along my flank and tickles.
I glance back to be sure you are still there.
On the climb I slow down so I will not slide.
After rain the mud is soft and my prints deep.
I pick dry ground; wet soil hurts my claws.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，把自己藏好。
lines.en: I flatten down and tuck myself out of sight.

lines.zh: 尾巴一下一下拍着地面。
lines.en: My tail taps the ground, once, then again.

lines.zh: 这片坡的草够高，很安全。
lines.en: The grass on this slope is tall enough.

lines.zh: 我听着远处有没有蹄声。
lines.en: I listen for hooves somewhere out beyond.
I am just hungry; that is not the same as afraid.

lines.zh: 眼睛眯起来，看得更清楚。
lines.en: Half-closed eyes see the horizon better.

lines.zh: 我把头搁在前爪上歇一会。
lines.en: I rest my head across my forelegs a while.
A bird is calling much too close to me.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫声会招来麻烦。
lines.en: I stay quiet; calling would bring trouble.
No water in this wood; that suits me.

lines.zh: 风换了方向，我换个姿势。
lines.en: The wind turned, so I shift my stance.
My back itches, so I give one shake.
I count clouds and wait for the dark.

lines.zh: 你在我旁边站着，我就不动。
lines.en: While you stand beside me, I hold still.

lines.zh: 你手里没有牛肉，我看看就走。
lines.en: No raw beef in your hand; I will look elsewhere.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛移动得太快了。
lines.en: Your eyes are darting around too quickly.

lines.zh: 不打我，我就多看你一会。
lines.en: Do not hit me and I will keep looking.
Are you holding anything I could eat?
I tilt my head to get a clear look.
You do not smell anything like grass.

lines.zh: 你的靴尖一动，我就后撤。
lines.en: The moment your boot shifts, I withdraw.
I recognize the calluses on your hands.
We stare like this; which of us moves first?
No hands yet; let me smell you first.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔会跟着你变大。
lines.en: My pupils widen to follow your movement.
You are standing rather close to my saddle.
These eyes see a great deal farther than yours.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸太浅，我听得见。
lines.en: Your breathing is shallow; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 生牛肉的味道，让我抬头。
lines.en: The smell of raw beef makes me look up.

lines.zh: 你手里要是肉，我就走近些。
lines.en: If that is meat in your hand, I will come closer.

lines.zh: 你那一下落在肋侧，我腿软了。
lines.en: That landed on my ribs and my legs gave.
I pull back with my tail held low.
That blow makes me want to run.
Not the back; there is no armor there.
My legs go weak and will not hold.
The wound is bleeding; I will lick it clean.
I am panting hard; please do not chase.
That one frightened me more than hurt me.
I back up the slope and watch you again.
If you truly want me, stop swinging that.

lines.zh: 牛肉还是生的？我闻到了。
lines.en: Is that beef raw? I can smell it.

lines.zh: 你把它举高，我就会过去。
lines.en: Hold it higher and I will come over.
Stop waving it; my jaw starts to shake.
Raw beef beats cooked; remember that.
My mouth is already watering for it.

lines.zh: 你这块肉，够换一个朋友。
lines.en: That piece of meat would buy a friend.
I am coming closer; do not snatch it back.
Beef or nothing; those are my terms.
Step back two paces, then I will eat.
Delicious, and gone again far too soon.
You bumped me and my whole body shifted.
One sideways nudge; my bones are light.
I pull away; that trick will not work.
My snout just bumped into your leg.
Do not crowd me; the saddle is over there.
Only my claws kept me upright there.
That knock made my tail whip around.
Easy there; my back is not thick.
I circle you once, then settle in place.

lines.zh: 我背后没长眼，别贴上来。
lines.en: I have no eyes back there; keep off.
Set the raw beef down first; then we talk.
I do not chase; I simply wait to be chosen.
Not the neck; that spot is far too ticklish.
When the tails twine, I understand.
You eat beef too? That is a good sign.
When I lower my head, that is a yes.
Let us walk one slow circle together.
Not so fast; walk beside me first.
With the saddle off, everything feels freer.

lines.zh: 我只认一个愿意喂我的人。
lines.en: I only choose whoever is willing to feed me.

lines.zh: 这块牛肉掉地上了，归我。
lines.en: That beef hit the ground; it is mine.

lines.zh: 牛肉我闻两下，才敢下口。
lines.en: I sniff the beef twice before I bite.
Only this much fits inside my saddlebags.
I do not collect stones; they chip my teeth.
You dropped the rein; here, take it back.
I chew a stalk of grass just for fun.
That scrap is too small to bend down for.
A bone will do for my teeth; I keep it.
Loaded full, everything rattles when I run.
Your things stay yours; I do not take them.

lines.zh: 我盯住那只兔子，肚子在叫。
lines.en: I fix on that rabbit; my stomach growls.

lines.zh: 前面有东西动，我先伏下。
lines.en: Something moved ahead; I drop low first.
Is the target you, or the meat you carry?

lines.zh: 我看见威胁了，先记住位置。
lines.en: I mark the threat and note where it stands.
My ears swing round; the sound is there.
That quarry cannot outrun me at all.
I am not cowering; I am getting ready.
Do not stand in front; you block my view.
That target is covered in iron plate.
I have it marked, though I would rather run.
Something is watching us; look behind.
The shadow in the grass is mine to take.
Only with my exit fixed do I look at you.
That one is too small; I want a bigger.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，随时能弹出去。
lines.en: I coil low, ready to spring at any moment.

lines.zh: 两腿绷紧，尾巴在数拍子。
lines.en: My legs tighten; my tail counts the beat.
Hold still; I am judging the distance.
I weave side to side so you cannot aim.
The moment you raise a hand, I retreat.

lines.zh: 我不会先咬，除非你逼我。
lines.en: I will not bite first unless you force me.

lines.zh: 这一圈是试探，不是进攻。
lines.en: This circle is a test, not an attack.

lines.zh: 你的手指一动，我全身都紧。
lines.en: One twitch of your fingers tightens all of me.
The target moves; my claws move sooner.
I have it worked out; three strides away.
Do not flank me; I dislike that greatly.

lines.zh: 我咬合了一下，只是习惯。
lines.en: I snap my jaws once; only habit.
This has to be quick; no dragging it out.

lines.zh: 我选好了退路，就在左边。
lines.en: My escape route is chosen, off to the left.
I crouch low, flattening my tail first.
The foreclaw goes first, the teeth follow.
My teeth skidded off the leather and missed.
I lashed out once, and only lightly.
Claw marks like these last a long while.
Walk away and I close my mouth again.
It was your bracer my teeth found.

lines.zh: 这一下是我怕了才打的。
lines.en: That strike came out of fear, not courage.

lines.zh: 我一扭头，爪子顺势划出去。
lines.en: I twist my head and the claw follows through.
That was once; do not make it twice.
My claw tip split the leather of your boot.
I do not go for the throat; that is a rule.
Once it lands, I back up the slope.
You blocked it; you are stronger than I thought.
Do not blame me; your hand moved first.

lines.zh: 这片旱地没有水，正好生我。
lines.en: Dry ground with no water; the right place for me.
I lift my head out of the tall grass.

lines.zh: 主世界的坡地，我生在这里。
lines.en: Born on a hillside here in the overworld.
I open my eyes, then test the wind.
The grass is short; I find a better spot.

lines.zh: 一出生就想跑，这是本能。
lines.en: I wanted to run the moment I stood up.

lines.zh: 我抖掉背上的草籽和土。
lines.en: I shake the seeds and soil off my back.
This place is far from water; I like it.

lines.zh: 蹄声太密，我往林子里躲。
lines.en: Too many hooves about; I slip into the trees.
I remember exactly how this slope looks.
Just arrived, and my legs are still weak.
Who is beside me? Nobody move just yet.
Plenty of grass here, and plenty of insects.
The markings on my back are still damp.

lines.zh: 我在坡下的草里睁了眼。
lines.en: I opened my eyes in the grass below the slope.
First the wind, then I found my footing.

lines.zh: 这片旱坡给我留了块空地。
lines.en: This dry slope left me a patch of open ground.

lines.zh: 我抖掉背上的土，抬头看天。
lines.en: I shake the dirt off my back and look up.

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我整只都缩了。
lines.en: The moment fire nears, I curl up tight.

lines.zh: 摔下来时我压到了前腿。
lines.en: I came down on my own foreleg.
Too deep; my claws cannot find the bottom.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀起来又摔下。
lines.en: The blast lifted me and dropped me back.
An arrow in my shoulder slows my run.
Magic makes my legs stop obeying me.

lines.zh: 很久没吃牛肉了，我很虚。
lines.en: No beef in ages; I am running on empty.
The thunder shakes me more than the strike.
The void is black and has no ground for me.
